solver.note: Numerical error of the solver, not the model's error against a cell. Bounds the system declares on its outputs: charge_time_80 ±0.05 min, min_anode_potential ±0.5 mV, max_temperature ±0.1 degC.

uncertainty.model: The nominal thermal model was calibrated on the Chen 2020 discharges in their fixture; this lab's fixture may cool the cell differently. A lab test measures surface temperature, voltage and current, never the anode potential: the plating margin is always a forecast. Surface-temperature agreement does not validate the anode potential, core temperature or plating.
